subject: Request: Rapid go-to-market staffing for Q1 product launch
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: Request: Rapid go-to-market staffing for Q1 product launch

Marissa / Steph —

We need quick approval to hire a small, focused slate of GTM roles to hit the Q1 product launch (target ship date: 2027-02-15). Summary ask: 3 Senior Account Executives (AE II/III), 2 SDRs (mid-level) and 1 Solutions Engineer (SE). Rationale below; supporting deck and comp bands attached.

Why now:
- Launch requires dedicated named AE coverage across three strategic verticals (fintech, ecommerce, health). Existing quota coverage will create gaps for key pilot customers.
- Early pipeline indicates $2.1M ARR in 12 months if we secure 4 prioritized pilots; we need quota-bearing reps in the market by mid-Jan to hit discovery and demos cadence.

Headcount & compensation (proposed):
- 3x AE II/III — total OTE range $160k–$220k (band varies by geography).
- 2x SDR — OTE $70k–$95k.
- 1x Solutions Engineer (senior IC) — base $150k–$180k + modest variable.

Budget ask: one-time ramp reserve + 3 months of hiring fees ~ $210k (recruiter fees, sign-on cadence, ramp payments). Ongoing run-rate (fully on payroll) estimated at ~$1.32M annual OTE. Detailed numbers in comp spreadsheet.

Requested decision: approval to open requisitions and engage Fairview Talent for immediate sourcing; if approved we will run a condensed 3-week interview loop aiming to extend offers by 2027-01-10.

Attachments: headcount-request-deck.pdf, compensation-band-proposal.csv

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 'yes' from Finance for the ramp reserve (Vivek)
2) Marissa to confirm hiring prioritization and interview panel
3) Steph/Talent to lift reqs and approve agency engagement

Happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk through the deck this week.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, North America
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: Rapid go-to-market staffing for Q1 product launch

Karthik — thanks for the clear write-up. A few quick clarifying questions before I greenlight:

1) Can you confirm the expected ramp timeline per role (when do we expect quota attainment % by month)? I want to understand when revenue will start to show in forecast.
2) For the AE comp band: are these levels market-adjusted for SF vs Austin vs remote hires? Need to ensure we have structured bands and not ad-hoc offers.
3) Why 1 SE versus 2? Is that a blocker for delivery or can we lean on Solutions Architects in pre-sales for the first 8 weeks?
4) Will these hires be hiring-manager-owned (Sales ops vs product-led hiring)? Who is the owner for interview loop coordination?

If Finance signs off quickly, I'm inclined to prioritize: 2 AEs (fintech, ecommerce) + 1 SDR + 1 SE now, and hold 1 AE + 1 SDR for post-launch depending on early pipeline. That reduces immediate run-rate by ~33% but still covers critical verticals.

Ping me with the ramp table and region-specific bands; happy to approve once we have those.

-M

On Sun, Dec 20, 2026 at 09:15 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message and attachments]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Fairview Talent <sourcing@fairviewtalent.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: Rapid go-to-market staffing for Q1 product launch

Marissa — answers inline and added the ramp table to the deck (see updated attachment). Replied to each point below.

1) Ramp timeline (expected quota attainment):
- Month 1: 10% (onboarding, shadowing)
- Month 3: 40% (active pipeline + demos)
- Month 6: 80%
- Month 12: 100% (full attainment)

With the condensed hiring plan and pre-seeded pipeline (we already have 18 active inbound opportunities), we expect initial ARR contribution from hires by March, with $800–1,200k attributable ARR within 12 months if pilots convert.

2) AE comp bands: attached csv includes market multipliers for SF (+12%), NYC (+8%), Austin (baseline), remote hires calibrated to cost-of-living bands. We will propose location-targeted offers to keep comp consistent.

3) SE coverage: one senior SE is sufficient for demo/decking and pilot enablement for the first 8–10 weeks; we will borrow Solutions Architects from product for deep integrations on an as-needed basis. If pipeline accelerates faster than forecast, we will re-open for a second SE.

4) Hiring owner: Sales will own AEs and SDRs (myself as hiring manager); Steph/Talent to own the req creation, posting, and agency coordination. Interview panel will include 1 manager + 1 peer AE + 1 CS partner + hiring manager.

Budget update: I reduced immediate ask to cover 2 AEs + 1 SDR + 1 SE (as Marissa suggested) — updated numbers in the deck reduce ramp reserve to ~$138k.

Fairview: can you confirm your availability to source a first slate by 2027-01-04? We want 6–8 resumes per role in week one.

—Karthik

Karthik / team — reviewed the updated numbers. Finance can provision a one-time ramp reserve of $140,000 to support immediate sourcing and sign-on needs with the following conditions:

- Ramp reserve will be charged to Q1 GTM spend; hiring must provide weekly updates to Revenue Ops until first payroll run.
- Any sign-on bonuses > $15k require VP-level pre-approval.
- Offers must adhere to the attached comp bands; exceptions need justification in writing.

If those three conditions are acceptable, consider ramp reserve greenlit.

Vivek
VP Finance
Redwood Inference
